text:
Silver Price in 1990
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1990, the LBMA silver price fell 19.4% between 1990-01-31 ($5.21) and 1990-12-31 ($4.19). The highest sampled price was $5.21 in January and the lowest was $4.09 in November. The mean of these observations was $4.76. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
